result.topic_en: Bare calculations on sums of square roots of products of linear forms such as $\sqrt{x\xi}+\sqrt{y\eta}+\sqrt{z\zeta}=0$, apparently related to theta characteristics. They include tables of binary triples (characteristics), linear substitutions with parameters $\alpha,\beta,\gamma,\lambda,\mu$, and the solution of linear relations among them.

methods.what: Linear relation between three binary quadratic products, giving a sum of three square roots that vanishes
Linear condition among the variables with parameters
Assignment of binary characteristics to square roots of linear forms
Expression of a determinant-type quantity for solving the linear system
Sum formula combining the determinant expressions for $x$ and $z$
Determination of the parameter lambda from a special solution
